name: How do recent comparable sales affect the value of my luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: How do recent comparable sales affect the value of my luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recent comparable sales, known as 'comps,' are a critical benchmark for valuing your luxury condo. Appraisers and real estate agents analyze properties with similar characteristics (size, beds/baths, amenities, age, location) that have sold within the last 3-6 months. The closer the match in features and location, such as within the same building or a neighboring luxury complex in Brickell, the more accurately they reflect current market value and buyer expectations. This method helps establish a realistic price point based on actual market transactions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recent comparable sales of similar luxury condos establish a crucial benchmark for your property's market value by reflecting what buyers are currently paying.
